name: Out of stock - Maci Skirt

name: Sherilyn Jumpsuit
description: The Sherilyn Jumpsuit from MagMaLou is a summer jumpsuit with wide legs made in a light viscose material. Wear it with sneakers or boots, or even layer it over a turtleneck for cooler weather. You decide!

name: Stripe Wrap Maxi Dress

name: Høst Jumper

name: Blue Floral Blouse

name: Out of stock - Burgundy Micro Bag
description: This bag comes with a strap, and has silver hardware. The burgundy color will flatter almost every outfit.

name: Broderie Anglaise Mini Dress Sunny Garden
description: The Broderie Anglaise Mini Dress from by Timo's Pre Fall 22 collection. The dress comes in a light, airy and soft certified cotton and viscose mix. The dress has beautiful embroidery all over the dress and comes in the perfect mini length. Fitted at the waist with smocked elastic and half-length sleeves with puffs and elastic. Round neck with zip closure at the back.

description: The Bourgeois shoulder bag is made in a classic style. With its simple design spacious sophisticated and elegant. The short shoulder strap means that it hangs quite high on the body. On the inside there is a small inside pocket with a zip. Details such as zips and accessories are of high quality from an Italian manufacturer. Measurement: 34 cm x 17 cm x 6 cm and the shouldstrap is 78 cm long. The bag is made of calfskin.

name: A-lined Bandage Dress
description: Look stunning and serious with this beautiful viscose dress. This black bandage dress features shoulder pads and a 3/4 sleeve. Black A-lined dress from Hervé Leger.

name: Blush Rose Amy Earrings

name: Luann Dress

name: Lurex Wrap Skirt Orange
description: The Lurex wrap skirt features ruffles and bands to tie. The fabric is stretchy and shimmery, and is easy to style both up and down!

name: For sale - 2 Mullin Georgette Dress
description: This red dress is the perfect every dress. The loose fit and the classic silhouette makes it easy to layer, or wear on its own.

name: Polka Dot Blouse
description: This simple, but sweet shirt from Moods of Norway is a short sleeve button-up shirt made in a light, breathable fabric.

The cardigan is made up of scraps of leftover and surplus yarn and is crocheted together with yarn in 100% Norwegian wool.

name: 1 Clarion Orange Jacket
description: A lightweight jacket that can be worn as a statement on its own, or as a layering piece for colder days.

name: Mist Green Dagny Skirt

name: Satin Jacket
description: The Satin Jacket Blue from Stine Goya

description: The beautiful pattern woven Olli Midi Dress from Soft Rebels is designed in the most beautiful fabric. The dress has an elegant cut with a round neck and neck slit with a button, full-length sleeves with a slight puff and a tie at the waist for a perfect fit.

name: Mina Wool Coat Black
description: Mina is a lined coat with patchwork details in leather made in a relaxed fit and sleeves in regular length. It’s not only a trendy coat, but also made with sustainability in mind. This coat is produced of Italian wool that comes from stock fabric and has recycled leather trim and belt. It’s decorated with Rodebjer-logo press buttons in silver at front. Mina is designed with medium shoulder pads, welt pockets and ends below knee length. This is the perfect fall and winter coat. Fits true to size: Choose your normal size.

name: Aliquan Green Surikat Shirt
description: The Holzweiler Aliquan Green Surikat Shirt is a long sleeve shirt with open spread collar.

name: Amalie Dress Orange
description: The Urban Pioneers Amalie viscose dress is perfect for every occasion. The A-shape is loose, but style it with a belt and you have a totally different look. Your choice!

name: Vibe Checks Pants
description: The Vibe Checks Pants from Six Ámes are nice trousers with a regular fit, but slightly cropped at the ankle. The checkered print gives these pants a nice little pop.

name: Sena Halogen Dress
description: The Sena dress is the perfect lightweight sun dress, cut in a fitted silhouette. It features a fresh contrast color stripe, and closes with a hidden zipper in the back.

name: Amber Cardigan
description: The Amber Cardigan Kupong knit.wear is made in a soft cotton mix that keeps you cool and comfortable. This is timeless staple wear that adapts well to a Scandinavian climate and lifestyle. Its oversized with an inclusive fit. The model is 174 cm, a size 36/38 and wearing a size M.

name: Golden Utopian Universe Chain
description: Gorgeous gold plated silver chain. Chain length 45 cm, can be combined with all the necklaces from this collection. Use the t-bar lock in the front or back.

name: Benedicte Ski Jacket Fucha
description: The Benedicte Ski Jacket from Kari Traa is an insulated and water-repellent jacket for women, designed for winter sports. The high collar, adjustable hood and detachable snow skirt prevent cold winds from sneaking in. The material has a water-repellent treatment so you stay dry. The jacket has a close-fitting fit and has pockets where you can store your things. Combine with the feminine and sporty Benedicte Ski Pants and complete your wardrobe!

name: Soft Line Skirt Red Marker
description: The Soft Line Skirt from Oleana is made in a soft silk and wool blend fabric. Give your closet a dose of the elegant yet simple life with this A-line midi skirt. Match it with the Soft Line cardigan or wear it as is, you really can't go wrong with this gorgeous skirt!

name: Adela Dress Black
description: The Adela Dress is a strap dress. It comes with adjustable self-fabric tunnel drawstrings at both the front and back that also create a textured look. There is a hidden zipper at the side seam.

name: Black Pink Cadillac
description: This flowy midi dress has a smocked neck, and features two contrasting burnout patterns in the fabric and a small cut-out at the back of the neckline.

name: Silver Blue Fusion Connected Earrings
description: Silver earrings with blue nano gem stone. Anne Hasla designed the Fusion collection, and the inspiration for the collection is her own inherited jewelry.

name: Dais Shirt Ecru

name: Duck Egg Bellis Lace Trim Maxi Dress
description: This beautiful crocheted maxi dress features a black pattern and ruffled details. The pleated skirt is made in a heavy fabric that makes it flattering and flows when you walk.

name: Hyper Romance Navy Dress
description: This lovely crochet dress features a fun mermaid shape and daring, deep-v, ruffled neckline. Comes with a nude underdress to mid-thigh. Closes with zipper at the back.

name: Tanner Dress Camel
description: The Rodebjer Tanner dress is made in a relaxed fit with dropped shoulders and ends below mid-calf. The voluminous sleeves are designed in regular length. Tanner is made of a yarn in a soft brushed merino wool which makes it super soft to the body. It’s decorated with seam details on outside and a flared skirt part to create a unique look. A warm, stylish and feminine dress for all kind of occasions and situations.

name: Pinstripe Trousers Black
description: Nice pinstriped trousers from C.L.E.A.N by Christina Ledang. The trousers have a slightly loose fit and are cropped above the ankle.

name: White Spannslokket Big Shirt
description: This cool shirt features removable sleeves that invites to several different uses. It has voluminous sleeves and an oversized fit.

name: Phoebe V-Neck White
description: The Phoebe sweater is made in only natural materials, that will both keep you warm and comfortable. Perfect for the winter months, as well as for cold summer nights.

name: Enjoy Grey Shirt Dress

name: Oxford Banker Shirt Light Blue
description: TheOxford Banker Shirt Light Blue from Gant is a classic Oxford shirt with stripes. The shirt is turned in at the back and falls nicely. Perfect everyday shirt, which can also be used for finer occasion.

description: Kjell Nordström, a.k.a. Baron von Bulldog, is known for his outspokenness and spectacular fashion shows. “Black Rose by BVB” is his first womenswear collection, solely inspired by “the little black dress” and a tribute to the great fashion classics of the 20th century. With the mantra that all women are beautiful, regardless of age, ethnicity, body shape or gender, this collection is a collaboration between Nordström and the women’s cooperative and network for inclusion, Sisters in Business.

name: Yellow Basalt Skirt
description: Asymmetrical shiny satin skirt with panel. Waistband with zipper on side. Panel with adjustable drawstring for wrinkle effect.

name: Pleated Georgette Top
description: The Pleated Georgette Top from Ganni is a beautiful top in red with large flowers giving all the summer vibes. The top has a loose-fit, ties at the neck and has short sleeves.

description: The Aster Uni Scarf from Holzweiler is an oversized, large knitted sweater made from 100% wool in a lovely pastel color! The scarf is detail with stitching along the trim.

name: Light Blue Kyuu Dress
description: A delicate mint midi dress featuring a peephole front, and a heavy satin fabric that flows perfectly around your body.

name: Gila Long Dress
description: The Gila Long Dress from Samsøe & Samsøe is a super gorgeous dress with a lovely floral pattern. The dress has a nice structure in the material and is perfect for festive occasions. It features woven, inelastic quality, narrow shoulder straps (not adjustable), and a concealed zipper on the side.

name: Twisted Velvet Dress Dark Blue
description: The Twisted Velvet Dress from Self-Portrait has a concealed hook-and eye and cut-out detail at back. More exciting features are a plunge V-neck, puff shoulders, buttoned cuffs, and a knot and drape detail at bodice. This dress is guaranteed to turn heads.

name: Pernille Coat
description: The Pernille Coat is the trench coat of your dreams. It is thin and light-weight and comes with a belt and in a beautiful shade between brown and olive green, making this gorgeous coat your new closet staple.

name: Out of stock - 5 Mike Tee
description: The Mike Tee has an oversized fit and features an shimmering fabric that can be dressed up and down. Size up and pair with a belt for a dressy look.

name: Rongve Parka Black
description: The Kari Traa Rongve Parka is a down jacket for women that can be used all winter. It is developed for warmth and designed with style. The jacket is filled with 60/40 down insulation to keep you toasty warm in the cold. With the fixed hood up, your hands in your pockets and the stylish, draft-proof and ribbed cuffs around your wrists, you'll stay toasty warm. Several pockets also give you plenty of safe places for your belongings.

name: Lana Dress Red Merlot
description: The Lana Dress from Miss Nouvelle is a real showstopper. Hitting just below the knees, it features eye-catching contrast sleeves, a flattering cowl neckline, and alluring nipped waist, complete with an asymmetrical peplum and self-belt. Made of rayon crepe, to ensure an authentic drape and feel, this dress embodies the ideal 1940s aesthetic.

name: Out of Stock 3 - Streep Creme Coat
description: This amazingly soft and comfortable faux fur is all you need this winter. It features a large collar and a matching belt to tie around your waist.

name: Cotton Blue Stripe Pilou
description: This cotton shirt is perfect for your everyday or for an upcoming occasion. You can wear this garment in 8 different ways. Make everyday special, changing up your style with this versatile, creative, and minimal top.

name: Penny Boot Peach
description: The Penny Boot from Roccamore is handmade in Italy with a built-in gel pad for extra comfort. All Roccamore heels have been validated to relieve 26% of the pressure from the forefoot and 44% from the arch while walking. Heel height: 8 cm. Fits true to size.

name: Pink Floral Blouse
description: The Pink Floral Blouse from Ane Mone is a cute and feminine blouse. With its half-length sleeves and rounded neckline it’s the perfect blouse for spring and summer. Wear it with jeans for a casual look, or dress it up with a skirt for the perfect office outfit

name: Beige Sequin Maxi Dress
description: The perfect dress for that special occasion when you want to stand out. Pair it with your hair up and a red lip for that elegant look.

name: Ane Hiking Shorts Palm
description: The Ane Hiking Shorts from Kari Traa have a 4-way stretch and gusset in the crotch that lets you set the pace while the quick-drying fabric transports moisture away. The elastic, silicone-coated hem prevents the trousers from sliding down, and there are practical pockets on the thighs to keep essentials in. They are made from recycled polyester, and the OEKO-TEX® 100 certification means that the base/contrast fabrics are not harmful to health .

name: Sireene Skirt Pink Moon
description: The Sireene Skirt from Rodebjer is a printed crepe, shirred midi skirt with an elasticated waistband.

description: The Estelle Mini Dress from Murlong Cres features a low, scooped back with a tie feature, puffed sleeves, an invisible zipper, and a bias-cut skirt. Outer layer in 100% silk satin, 22mm. Fully lined in 100% organic cotton.

name: Juliette Dress Soft Floral Sky Blue
description: The Juliette Dress from By Malina features a deep V-neckline, cute floral details and a wrap front with a tie. The linen blend makes the dress perfect for spring and summer.

name: 1994 Feminine Sweater
description: The 1994 Feminine Sweater is a modern update of Dale of Norway's' biggest success ever, their official Olympic sweater for the Winter Olympics in Lillehammer in 1994. Cut and wool quality have been updated. The pattern has been kept more or less unchanged from the original and consists of symbols and figures from Norse mythology. A feminine, roomy cut with a slightly longer back than front brings an almost 30-year-old classic in step with our own times.

name: Out of stock - V-Neck Printed Midi Dress
Lana Melange Coat

name: Svalbard Wool High Neck Hindberry
description: The Svalbard Wool High Neck in hindberry is designed it to look authentically handmade, and the familiar bright red color is taken from the designer's Italian neighborhood. He grew up right next to Ferrari's original factory. 100% pure, new wool from Norwegian sheep and is one of Devold's by far warmest sweaters . Knitted in a two-tone full Jacquard. Comfortable rib at the bottom of the body and sleeves. PLEASE NOTE the sweater is knitted in an unisex model and we recommend women to go down one size.

name: Light Indigo Leonora Jeans

This denim jacket features long sleeves and a frayed edge around the collar. A classic!

description: The Kari Traa Eva Down Jacket is a light, water-repellent and super-insulated down jacket for women that will keep you warm in nature here in the north. No cold spots: The effective down filling stays in place and does not leak. Narrow cut and thin diagonal lines with compact padding make it ideal for layering. Super-elastic stretch fabric on the inside of the sleeves and on the sides prevents slipping and gives you full freedom of movement.

name: Navy Iza Dress
description: The perfect wrap dress for both day and night. Featuring a v-neck, long sleeves and a flowy skirt. Beautiful and elegant fabric that feels soft and comfortable.

name: Coin Necklace

name: Power Houdi Green Horizon
description: A Houdini classic. Fleece jacket in Polartec® Power Stretch® Pro™. Minimalist design that works both in extreme conditions and for everyday comfort.

name: Cognac Pollux Down Coat
description: Pollux is a long, comfy and warm parka. It features a matt surface, and will keep you warm down to -20 degrees.

name: Best Bud Top Blueberry

Match it with the Best Bud skirt, underneath a jacket, as a vest over a shirt, or just as it is. The possibilities are endless!

Elastic softshell with down-insulated front and back. It has Primaloft® Gold insulation and a windproof layer that keeps you warm and dry, perfect as a ski jacket in winter. Elastic panels under the arms and on the back provide optimal movement. Practical pockets with zips. High, warm and adjustable collar. Adjustable and removable hood for extra weather protection. The jacket has metallic details and a feminine and flattering cut. Combine with the feminine and sporty Advance Primaloft Pants and complete your wardrobe!

name: Alex Denim Shirt
description: Oversized unisex denim shirt in 100% cotton. Masculine button stand, right side overlaping left side.  Super cool and comfy, tucked in or worn loose over jeans. Great for Spring monts, over leggings, with jeans for a denim on denim look or over shorts or as a jacket with a dress, you choose!

No cold spots: The effective down filling stays in place and does not leak. The fixed hood has a weather brim and a super-delicious velvet lining, while the side pockets keep your hands warm and your things safe in the city.

name: Carrie Sweater Berry
description: The Carrie Sweater Kupong knit.wear is made in a soft wool blend of mohair and wool that keeps you warm and comfortable. It is designed with a mix of colors and pattern, for a fun and loving look. This is timeless staple wear that adapts well to a Scandinavian climate and lifestyle. The model is 179 cm, a size 38 and wearing a size M.

name: Vanilla Custard Stambecco Skirt
description: The Stambecco skirt is cut from a high quality 100% lightweight linen fabric. Made to be worn, this skirt is lined with a comfortable 100% cotton quality. Features pleasant details such as the clean and flattering slit in the front and tortoise shell buttons all the way down. It comes with a detachable belt creating a feminine silhouette. The design combined with the ideal material makes this skirt perfect for hot summer days and is a garment you can wear for many summers ahead.

name: Voss Anorak Sail
description: The Kari Traa Voss Anorak for ladies an outdoor jacket with a water-repellent, treated surface and ventilation openings in the mesh for extra ventilation. The adjustable waist and arm folds provide increased comfort, while a side zip allows you to easily take the anorak on and off when you're out for a walk. It is made from recycled materials.

name: Silk Satin Slip Dress
description: The Silk Satin Slip Dress from ESP is cut in luxurious silk that floats down your body. Designed with a low halter neckline, delicate strings and a open back.

name: Rapsodia Trousers Red
description: The Rapsodia Trousers by Marina Rinaldi are the pared-back style that never stray from your sartorial rotation. The strategically placed elastic material in the back and under the arms ensures mobility and ventilation. Rudolf Bionic Finish® Eco technology on the surface of the fabric further ensures that light rain and sleet bounce off, while ensuring good breathability. Insulated with Thermore® Ecodown, which consists exclusively of recycled fibers from PET bottles, this jacket provides warmth with improved durability throughout the life of the garment, while also having a lower environmental impact. It’s made from recycled polyester and is fully recyclable. The fabric can stand years of wear and tear and works just as fine on a rainy day in the city as on rough days in the mountains. Both the membrane and water repellent are completely free from PFAS. High performance does not have to come at the cost of a high environmental impact. If you are looking for a cozy raincoat to keep you dry in the roughest weather, One Parka is your match. If you layer up underneath, it will keep you warm all through winter and we can even recommend bringing it to the ski slopes when the conditions are wet.

name: W's Mono Air Jacket Misty Beach
description: The latest innovation from Houdini and Polartec® is not only made to keep you warm and dry on any adventure. The Mono Air fabric is specifically designed to combat plastic waste. It sheds 80% less microfibers compared to conventional fleece and is made from recycled and recyclable materials. A fleece that is both anti-shedding and circular is nothing less than groundbreaking. When you feel the warmth on a cold mountain hike or a chilly morning at the climbing crag, you should also feel the comfort of contributing to a world without waste. In a conventional fleece, the cut-off fibers that create the fuzzy structure are exposed and can therefore shed from the garment during wash or when you use it. In Mono Air, endlessly long and lofty fibers are knitted into small pockets between a face and back fabric. The pockets trap warm air from your body to create insulation and at the same time protect the insulating fibers from escaping. The face of the fabric is reinforced with a hardface treatment that prevent pilling and snagging. The result is a smooth and strong fabric that will keep you warm and endure years of hard use. The Mono Air Jacket is a lightweight insulation garment for four season use. The light, stretchy and durable fabric works perfectly as an outer layer or as insulation underneath a ski jacket or a winter coat. Mono Air Crew has been field tested for ski touring, rock climbing, alpine trekking, and many other demanding adventures. The snug collar and the densely knitted face fabric takes the worst edge of the wind but the garment is still highly breathable and easy to vent thanks to the front zipper. Treat it well and it will become a lifelong companion.

name: W's Mono Air Houdi Purple Heather
description: The Mono Air Houdi from Houdini is an innovation both in terms of performance and sustainability. The Mono Air fabric is specifically designed to combat plastic waste. It sheds 80% less microfibers compared to conventional fleece and is made from recycled and recyclable materials. A fleece that is both anti-shedding and circular is nothing less than groundbreaking. When you feel the warmth on a cold ski tour in the backcountry, when you snuggle up during a coffee break at the climbing crag, you should also feel the comfort of contributing to a world without waste. In a conventional fleece, the cut-off fibers that create the fuzzy structure are exposed and can therefore shed from the garment during wash or when you use it. In Mono Air, endlessly long and lofty fibers are knitted into small pockets between a face and back fabric. The pockets trap warm air from your body to create insulation and at the same time protect the insulating fibers from escaping. The face of the fabric is reinforced with a hardface treatment that prevent pilling and snagging. The result is a smooth and strong fabric that will keep you warm and endure years of hard use.

name: Black V-neck Vest
description: The Filippa V-neck Vest is following the path laid out by the successful ALBA Carla Vest: the younger sister is knitted in the same yarn quality, but with a leaner silhouette. The new Filippa vest is slightly shorter with a generous V-neck. It is beautiful over a crisp shirt or a blouse.

name: Jacket Challenge 2.0 Wmn Snow White
description: The Jacket Challenge 2.0 from Dæhlie is perfect for training outside on cold winter days. Consisting of wind and water repellent 3-layer softshell upgraded with PU membrane, designed to keep moisture out, while transporting moisture from the inside, so the jacket both dries quickly and breathes well during high-intensity training sessions. Designed with quilted padding on the chest area most exposed to the cold, this jacket will keep you warm on even the coldest days. The padding is designed to trap moisture, with a laminated front that ensures that the moisture is not absorbed and freezes in the garment. The strategically placed elastic material in the back and under the arms ensures mobility and ventilation. Rudolf Bionic Finish® Eco technology on the surface of the fabric further ensures that light rain and sleet bounce off, while ensuring good breathability. Insulated with Thermore® Ecodown, which consists exclusively of recycled fibers from PET bottles, this jacket provides warmth with improved durability throughout the life of the garment, while also having a lower environmental impact. Designed as part of a set, you can combine this jacket with the Pants Challenge 2.0 to complete the perfect outfit for cold days!

name: Dots Hot Pink Eat To The Beat Top

Cupro is also known as vegan silk. It truly is a game-changing fabric because it’s also hypoallergenic, anti-static, stretch-resistant, incredibly durable and, being thermo-regulating, it dries quickly.

name: Emmalou Sleeve Green Dress

description: A stunning dress from Vince with a V-neck, dropped shoulders and short sleeves with volume and folds. Place in the front and knit in the back for a feminine touch. The dress comes witha matching tie belt in the same fabric. Normal to slightly good in size.

Combine with the feminine and sporty Advance Primaloft trousers and complete your wardrobe!

The flap and the stitching details gives the bag a uniquely interesting look that stands out. The single handle is adjustable and make the bag perfect for shoulder bag use. Thea comes with matching lining and an internal pocket. With this bag you can both look your best and keep our planet safe a little more. Dimensions: 30 x 14 x 9 cm.

name: 1 Aemiley Dress
description: This is the perfect piece to add to your wardrobe. It comes in a silk crepe with a leopard print, and a draped V-neck in the front and back.

name: Annlaug Jet Black Sweater
description: The Annlaug sweater is a super cosy and comfortable pullover made in a high-quality alpaca blend. It features a ribbed neckline, hem and cuffs, a loose fit and details such as the long slits in the side seam.

name: Milana LS Mohair Knit
description: The Milana LS Mohair Knit is American Dreams' iconic mohair knit. It is designed with love in Copenhagen and made with care around every detail in Italy. Milan is knitted in a light and airy mohair mix - which makes it the perfect summer knit! The jumper has loose sleeves with ribbed cuffs, low shoulder seam, V-neck and an oversized fit. We love this fresh colour, and use it for all spring and summer outfits.

name: Sequin Ruffle Dress Vanilla
description: The sequin mesh midi ruffle dress is part of ROTATEs icons collection featuring a curated selection of show-stopping pieces. It is a mid-length dress, that is crafted in a sheer mesh material with beads all over. It has dramatic ruffles around the wide neckline and closes with a zipper on the back. Wear it with or without the slip dress it comes with.

name: Bagru Print Blouse
description: The Studio Bazar Bagru Print Blouse is made with 100% cotton. It's style features bagru print with chest piece and wide puffed sleeves. Perfect for any season.

name: Ruffle Top
description: This black ruffle top is perfect to pair with a statement skirt for a look that stands out. The sleeveless cut makes it versatile to layer under blazers for colder days, but looks just as good on its own.

name: Army Check Bridget Skirt
description: Bridget Skirt is a denim skirt from the Holzweiler. The skirt stops above the knee and has belt loops at the waistband.

name: Kitty Dress Peacock Pattern
description: The Urban Pioneers Kitty viscose wrap dress is perfect for any occasion. The adjustable belt makes it easy for you to make it fit perfectly and can be styled with heels, sneakers or even over a pair of jeans. It's also perfect to wear to the beach over a bikini!

name: Camilla Jacket Royal
description: The Camilla Jacket from Kari Traa is a ladies' ski jacket that is very warm. It has warm hand pockets, a goggle pocket and a lift card pocket. The chin guard, the adjustable wrists and the hood ensure that the cold does not get in. Camilla has a down insulation that gives you extra warmth and the chevron seams add a cool touch to the elegant look.

name: Mona Shirt Dress
description: The Mona Shirt Dress from Six Ámes is a nice, tight-fit dress. The dress features a stiff collar, long sleeves and a belt at the waist for a more fitted look.

name: Out of stock - Riposte Rhombic Dress
description: This flirty and ultra-chic pink dress features an embroidered pattern with a v-neckline at the front and the back. The lined dress features narrow straps and pockets at the side and a back zipper fastening for discreet closure.

name: Issey Sweater Rasberry
description: Issey sweater is made in 100% soft merinowool that keeps you warm and comfortable. This is the perfect go-to sweater when you want to dress up or just look great!

name: Fam Short Sweater Brown
description: The Fam Short Sweater is a Hést bestseller and signature sweater in a shorter model. It is a oversized shape with loose and high neck, wide sleeves and is longer in the back. PLEASE NOTE: someone who wears a small can wear this sweater just as well as someone who wears a large.

name: Summer Strap Lavender Dress
description: The Summer Strap Dress is both adorable and charming. The upper part of the dress is made in jersey which is pliable and comfortable and the skirt is made in shiny viscose, which has a heavy and fine fall. The black knit straps and belt at the waist tighten up the dress giving is a great fit. Perfect for all your summer parties.

name: Milly Wrap Dress Pink Floral
description: The Milly Wrap Dress in pink floral from American Dreams is made from breathable light voile that's perfect for warm summer days. It's printed with flowers and has playful ruffles cascading down the front.

name: Nordsjø Wool Sweater Off White
description: The Nordsjø Wool Sweater is made from 100% pure Norwegian wool, which makes it both uniquely insulating and breathable. The North Sea sweater has been seen for a century as the original Norwegian knitted sweater. It was also the inspiration behind American L.L. Bean's iconic Preppy sweater. 100% pure, new wool from Norwegian sheep. Comfortable rib at the bottom of the body and sleeves. Knitted in a two-tone Jacquard. PLEASE NOTE the sweater is knitted in an unisex model and we recommend women to go down one size.

name: Denim Shirt
description: The Denim Shirt from M.A.P.P is a loose fitting shirt, made of 100% cotton denim. It has a collar and decorative push buttons.

name: Sold - Julienne Skirt Oleander
description: This flowy floral wrap skirt works perfectly with a cropped top and wedge sandals. Bring it on your vacay and dress it down for the beach, and up for a cocktail dinner.

name: Gardenia 93 Til Infinity
description: This loose fit, warm and comfy knit sweater features a high neck, ribbed cuffs, and is the perfect companion for cooler seasons.

name: Marine Lolita Green Midi Dress
description: The Marine midi dress is a versatile and flattering style, that works both for a dinner date as well as a coffee date. Dress it up or down depending on the look you're going for.

name: Raven Black Tyssendal Mittens
description: Down and feather filled with RSW down. Reflective logo and detachable string. The string takes us back to our childhood, and the best part? You will never loose one of your mittens again. Wear the string on the inside of your jacket, or on the outside, whatever you would like.

name: Crépe Satin Strap Dress Black
description: The Crépe Satin Strap Dress by TiMo is a lovely dress in viscose, with straps and frills at the bottom. It has decorative smock details all over, and is figure-hugging.

name: Margit Broderie Anglais Bright White Dress
description: The Margit dress is inspired by the strong flare, flirty and femininity of women in the late 70’s. The romantic fabric with broderie anglaise and the waistband makes this dress feminine and fun. This style is sure to get that summer glow flowing.

name: Ellinor Nude Metallic
description: The Ellinor is a joyful party bag for when you dress up. Wear it on your hand or by the detachable metal shoulder strap. It will go well with your festive dress or even jeans and pumps and a glass of champagne! Width: 16,5 cm Height: 9 cm Depth: 3 cm Shoulder strap length: 116 cm

name: Phoebe V-Neck White
description: The Phoebe sweater is made in only natural materials, that will both keep you warm and comfortable. Perfect for the winter months, as well as for cold summer nights.

name: Not available - Custom-made Yellow Ruffle Gown
description: This amazing custom-made dress screams modern elegance. It features a slim bodice and ruffles on the sleeves and skirt. It's been to a party before, and therefore has some wear and tear, some spots and rifts. It's part of the charm!

name: Forever Black Plissé Dress
description: The Forever Black Plissé Dress is a chic, pleated midi dress. The dress features a round neck, long sleeves, and a nice A-line skirt. This flowy beauty can be dressed up with your favorite heels or even worn with sneakers for a more casual look. Either way, you can't go wrong with this gorgeous dress!

name: Kyte Parka Black
description: The Kari Traa Kyte Parka is a versatile women's jacket for cold days in the city. The relaxed fit and long cut give it an urban look, while the practical features keep you nice and warm. No cold spots: The effective down filling stays in place and does not leak. The fixed hood has a weather brim and a super-delicious velvet lining, while the side pockets keep your hands warm and your things safe in the city.

name: Black Cupro Maxi Dress
description: A unique maxi dress from Just Female that can be dressed up or worn casually, you decide!

name: Sulana Clear Pink Blouse
description: Feel and look great with this versatile everyday top. Features layered detailing and a knot front. A perfect starting point for any layering piece.

name: Black and White Bjorøy Sweater
description: The wool sweater is made of 100% fine, Norwegian wool from the sheep's very first cut. The fibers are short, which gives a finer and softer yarn.

name: Flerken Wrap Top Blue
description: The Flerken Wrap Top from Mette Møller is a fresh and energetic wrap top in thick and firm jersey. It is feminine and easy to wear with both skirts and trousers. Remember to wrap the top well around you before tying it.

name: Tearz Vanilla Ice Top
description: The Tearz top is a super comfortable form fitting viscose top featuring an open collar with a ribbed V-neck. This top looks great with a variety of outfits, wear it with light separates during warmer months or layer it for fall.

name: Voss Pant Marine
description: The Voss Ski Pant from Kari Traa is made from recycled plastic from Primaloft insulation. Voss Ski Pant is therefore water-repellent, breathable, light, insulates heat and is more durable than down insulation. Construction seams and articulated knees and a crotch gusset let you rip it up. The double front zips are too easy to take on and off and use colored zips to make a statement.

name: Star Earrings
description: These beautiful silver monogram star earrings are the perfect pair with your next outfit. Features the classic Dior "D" in stunning silver.

name: Henry Necklace Silver
description: Plate necklaces are a go-to item in any wardrobe. The Henry necklace in 925 Sterling Silver is inspired by one of our own heirlooms, with classic details from the 70’s. Wear it alone or combine it with several necklaces for an even more distinct look. Measurements: Pendant size: 1,5 cm x 2,5 cm, Chain thickness: 2,10 mm, Length:  22´´ / 55,8 cm

name: 1 Cropped Flare Ribbed Pants
description: These burgundy cropped flare pants are a comfy way to look classy. These are stretchy, and ensures a perfect fit.

name: Eva Down Jacket Marine
description: The Kari Traa Eva Down Jacket is a light, water-repellent and super-insulated down jacket for women that will keep you warm in nature here in the north. No cold spots: The effective down filling stays in place and does not leak. Narrow cut and thin diagonal lines with compact padding make it ideal for layering. Super-elastic stretch fabric on the inside of the sleeves and on the sides prevents slipping and gives you full freedom of movement.

name: Ryder Crepe Navy Flower Dress
description: The Ryder Crepe Navy Flower Dress from Ganni has a ruffle that goes all around the waist and has a half slip attached to the bottom skirt. It closes with two buttons in the back of the neck.

name: Edda Dress
description: This patterned dress has a classic silhouette, and features shimmering details, a high neck and long sleeves.

name: 3 Ginger Spice Fluffy Knit
description: A chunky and comfortable knit sweater in a great fall color. Features beautiful details on the sleeves.

name: Verdens Army Jacket
description: The Verdens Army Jacket from Holzweiler is acargo bomber jacket with dropped shoulders. The jacket features a collar with zipper opening, yoke panel with front shifted shoulders, cargo patch pockets on front and elastic cuffs. The jacket is fully lined.

name: Collard Black Jacket
description: This black leather jacket is cut from a soft lambs leather and is fully lined. The metal details gives the jacket a biker look.

name: Jaelyn Dress
description: The Jealyn dress from Nümph features a round neck and long sleeves. The dotted pattern gives it a fun look. Style it both for work and a late night dinner.

name: Dots Hot Pink I Love To Love Dress
description: Loose fitting swing dress with long sleeves made in 100% organic cotton.

name: Deep V-Neck Wrap Blouse
description: This amazing wrap top features a chic floral print. Wear on its own, or pair with stockings to dress it down for a more casual look.

name: Kiss Blouse Blue
description: The Kiss Blouse is perfect for any occasion and is both business and casual. It has a round neck and slightly flared quarter length sleeves and the light viscose material makes it comfortable for the warmest of days — this is definitely a summer go-to.

name: Green Dots Je T'aime
description: This vegan dyed long dress is cut in a loose fit, and features a pleated contoured waistline, keyhole neck opening, long tiered hem and oversized cuff.

name: Cut Out Collared Top White
description: The Cut Out Collared Top by Aris will be this summer's go-to. This sexy sleeveless is tight fitting and can be worn at any occasion. Wear it with jeans and your favorite boots for a cool, spunky look or wear it with a skirt and high heels for night around the town.

name: Fam Knit Sweater Light Green
description: The Fam Knit Sweater is a Hést bestseller and signature sweater in a longer model. It is a oversized shape with loose and high neck, wide sleeves and is longer in the back. PLEASE NOTE: someone who wears a small can wear this sweater just as well as someone who wears a large.

name: Floral Shift Dress Turmeric
description: The Floral Shift Dress in tumeric from ByTimo features small pleats at the round neck and side pockets.

name: Faye Shoulder Dress Blue

name: Esilca Purple Sequin

name: Daphne Dress Lula Dot Print
description: The Daphne Dress will be a favorite this summer. It features a round neck, tie sleeves and a ruffled hemline.

name: Obleka Rosannacras Dress
description: The Obleka Rosannecras Dress is stunning slightly loose-fitting dress with a round neck and balloons sleeves. The gorgeous floral print makes this dress the perfect summer staple piece.

name: Black Huglo Skirt
description: A mid length knitted skirt is a must-have in the Scandinavian wardrobe. Style it up or down depending on the occasion.

name: Misu Mini Pican
description: The Misu Mini Bag from Cala Jade is the cutest bag in town. This hand-braided bag will lighten up your outfits. It fits the small things you need for a stroll, and with the shoulder strap you can choose to carry her close to your body. Misu Mini also has a removable inner bag with a credit card pocket and magnet closure. Measurements: width: 16cm, height: 17cm, depth: 11cm, handle length: 24cm, inner strap length: 120cm.

name: 1 Rose Dust Tiana Top
description: The Tiana Top is cut in a classic fit, and features an Art Deco-print. It comes with a bow to tie around your neck.

description: GANNI perfects your tailoring power-look, with this draped blazer. Taking you from the office to party, it continues on the label’s sustainability journey, made from a recycled-blend with a subtle tonal stripe throughout. Ruched sides accentuate the waist and the Scandi-cool brand’s logo is embroidered at the collar.

name: Coola Boola Orange Biodegradable Sunglasses
description: The Coola Boola Sunglasses from Kaibosh are 100% Norwegian design.

name: Røthe Midlayer Nwhit Navy
description: The Kari Traa Røthe is an insulated mid-layer sweater with lots of warmth, comfort and a modern, sporty design. It's easy to see why it's a bestseller: the soft teddy fleece is super delicious. The high collar and ribbed cuffs keep the cold out. The cuffs are also a style element and prevent the sleeves from sliding up when you put on a layer on top. The chest pocket with logo adds class to the garment.

name: Dodici Dress Black
description: The Dodici Dress from Maina Rinaldi is a dressier version of the sack dress. She has a jewelled neckline and a comfortable fit.

name: OOS - Splash Gold Earrings
description: Unique handmade jewelry, made of porcelain and sterling silver. Decorated with glaze and gold/silver.

name: Green Bahamas Blazer

name: Gry Midi Dress

The large, round volume is emphasized by the rounded lower edge which can be further laced together with an elastic cord.This large but light garment will take good care of you in the cold winter days.

name: Sigrid Pants Vegetal
description: Sigrid from Rodebjer is a relaxed fit pant made in mid-rise waist and ends in ankle length. This pair of pants are designed with an elastic waist which makes them very comfortable to wear. Fits true to size: Choose your normal size.

name: Duana Black Jacket
description: Get the warmth you need during the cold winter months with this feminine down jacket. The figure-hugging fit and colour design will really make a statement on the ski slopes. Features fast ThermoCore, premium core, and 3D technology.

name: Honey Midi Dress Fair Orchid
description: The Honey Midi Dress from Second Female is a nice long-sleeved dress. The dress is wide in shape, which makes it very comfortable to wear.

name: Noah Scarf Pink
description: The Noah Scarf from Christian Aks is a lovely accessory made from soft lambswool for the cooler seasons.

name: Out of stock - Capella Mesh Skirt
description: This beautiful floral mesh skirt is the perfect everyday staple. Pair it with your favorite t-shirt and sandals for summer, or boots and a turtleneck for spring and fall.

name: Black Ruffle Wrap Dress
description: A full-length wrap dress featuring a deep v-neckline and flattering skirt. Pairs perfect with a clutch of your choice. The v-neckline cut is not bra friendly.

name: Grey Cortina 1956 Sweater
description: This wool sweater is made in 100% Norwegian and has become a popular retro sweater. This unisex garment has measurements corresponding to our men's sizes. If you use a women's size, we recommend that you choose a size smaller than usual.

name: Metallic Leopard Top
description: This bold top is made in a thick but stretchy knit material, and features an all-over leopard print with metallic threads.

name: M1 Blake Blouse
description: A classic blouse with a round neck, and buttons down the front. Perfect for work.

name: To The Last Red Plissé Dress

This flowy beauty can be dressed up with your favorite heels or even worn with sneakers for a more casual look. Either way, you can't go wrong with this gorgeous dress!

name: Golden Utopian Universe Chain

Interior: 88% viscose, 12% silk.

name: Demora Dress Dark Green

name: Black Floral Top
description: This lovely floral top from Baum und Pferdgarten is a fitted long-sleeve blouse with a slightly stretchy, smocked body and ruffled hem.

name: Robyn Stretch Leather Trousers
description: The Robyn Stretch Leather Trousers from Riccovero are slim-fit leather pants with small ruffle details on each side.

name: 2 Avalon Dress
description: This elegant silk dress features a light A-line silhouette with a slightly ruffled hem. The detailed buttons gives the dress a luxurious look.

name: Chinois Green Terrytowel Trackpant
description: These classic trackpants features a normal stretch waist, straight legs, and pockets in the front.

name: Mellomholmene Grey Shell Dress
description: This printed dress has a voluminous silhoette, ruching details on the sleeves and elastic hems. The mid length sleeves gives it a more feminine vibe.

name: Vatusia Blouse Black
description: Vatusia from Rodebjer is a blouse made with voluminous sleeves that ends in elbow length. The blouse ends in seat length and has a smock at back for a fitted waist. Vatusia is designed in Rodebjer’s lovely seasonal print. Runs small in size, if you are between sizes take the larger size.

name: Not available - Sky Blue Strap Gown
Prenestina Jacket Baby Blue Jacket
description: Super elegant, constructed jacket with puffed shoulders, emphasized waist. All details in gold finish. Made in hight quality cotton twill and fully lined. Perfect for those Spring and Summer night, over a dress, a skirt, with jeans or as a top to go under a light trench.

name: Azaela Mini Dress
description: Embody Self-Portrait’s elegant design aesthetic in this unabashedly romantic and flirtatious Azaelea dress. Exemplifying exceptional attention to detail, it features a lace overlay with intricate floral motifs, presented against a contrasting lining to keep them in full focus.

name: Sleeveless Dress w/ Ruffle
description: The Sleeveless Dress w/ Ruffles from 3.1 Philip Lim features a high round neck with darting at the bust and a shift silhouette and an asymmetric wrap front ruffle hem.

name: Zeta Dress
description: The Zeta Dress from RAVN RAVN is a fun and sexy short style with a high neck and wavy skirt. It is a great dress for a playful day look with sneakers or an elegant evening look with high heels.

name: Black Crossover Dress
description: The Black Crossover Dress is a modern structured dress in bonded fabric. The crossover strap details finish at the waist for a cinched in effect, creating a flattering hourglass figure. Faux welt pockets provide extra detailing to the minimalist tailored skirt wiht a hidden zip back closure.

name: Black Belted Cardigan
description: This light viscose cardigan with a belt around the waist is super soft and can be used as a stand-alone piece or be combined with a nice top!

name: Gatelang's Sweater
description: Gatelang's Sweater is a chunky hand-knit sweater from Bernt Knitwear. The sweater is part of the book "Bernt - Strikk med restegarn", but for anyone who can't knit, the entire collection from the book can be rented here. The sweater is knitted with surplus and leftover yarn in a mixture of Norwegian wool, alpaca and mohair and keeps me warm even on the coldest days. The jumper has an oversized fit and can fit several sizes.

name: Walta Dress Violet Blue
description: Walta from Rodebjer is a fitted dress made in a mid-thigh length and with sleeves in regular length. It’s designed in Rodebjer seasonal print. Walta is decorated with a trendy flounce collar, a loose back yoke and oversized cuffs in white contrast cotton fabric. Fits true to size: Choose your normal size.

name: Spectra Ring Rose Combo
description: The Spectra ring are made of Swarowski crystals, and are slightly adjustable. Features the colors Vintage rose, Antique pink and burgundy.

name: Out of stock - Sequin Kimono Maxi Dress
description: This summary deep v-neck dress will give your body the stylish movement you're looking for. Features a stretchy-waist, flared arms, and an open slit in the back for the perfect fit and optimal comfort.

name: Røthe Windbreaker Pine
description: The Røthe Windbreaker from Kari Traa has a relaxed silhouette and fabric mix that gives it a cool patchwork design. This is designed to stop the wind using wind-resistant fabric, as well as the soft dart keeping you comfortable. The chin guard with zip and the drawstring at the waist mean that you can easily regulate the temperature.

name: Sold - Romy Flower Blue Dress
description: This elegant flowery dress features beautiful flounces on the arms and a round neckline. Pairs well with a waist belt.

name: 3 Otter Dress
description: This amazing midi dress comes in a lovely color combination that can be worn both with heels and sneakers. The flowy silhouette makes it suitable for all shapes and sizes.

name: Sibylle 40s Trousers Grey
description: Be suited and booted with The Sibylle 40s Trousers from Collectif x Manillusion! The trousers are vintage inspired pleated trousers with a high waisted fit, a wide cut, and are hemmed approximately below the ankle.

name: Jacket Challenge 2.0 Wmn Snow White
description: The Jacket Challenge 2.0 from Dæhlie is perfect for training outside on cold winter days. Consisting of wind and water repellent 3-layer softshell upgraded with PU membrane, designed to keep moisture out, while transporting moisture from the inside, so the jacket both dries quickly and breathes well during high-intensity training sessions. Designed with quilted padding on the chest area most exposed to the cold, this jacket will keep you warm on even the coldest days. The padding is designed to trap moisture, with a laminated front that ensures that the moisture is not absorbed and freezes in the garment. The strategically placed elastic material in the back and under the arms ensures mobility and ventilation. Rudolf Bionic Finish® Eco technology on the surface of the fabric further ensures that light rain and sleet bounce off, while ensuring good breathability. Insulated with Thermore® Ecodown, which consists exclusively of recycled fibers from PET bottles, this jacket provides warmth with improved durability throughout the life of the garment, while also having a lower environmental impact. Designed as part of a set, you can combine this jacket with the Pants Challenge 2.0 to complete the perfect outfit for cold days!

name: Silver Blue Cézanne Necklace
description:
Gourgeous silver necklace with light blue nano gem stone.
Chain length 50 cm, beautifully combined with Utopian Universe necklace.

name: Linnea Shirt
description: This chic satin top features dropped shoulders, an internal tie-fastening, and a drawstring waist. Perfect to dress both up and down.

name: Aria Shirt Warm Sand
description: The Aria from Rodebjer is a relaxed fitted summer shirt designed with regular shoulders and with normal sleeve length. This shirt is designed in a comfy, straight fit with chest pockets. Aria is decorated with small slits in the side seams which create a flowy and feminine silhouette.

name: Bilbao Scarf The Worker
description: The Bilbao Scarf is a delicious, large and soft scarf knitted in merino wool. The pattern is a stylized photo of the designer taking a close-up of one of the steel sculptures in Richard Serra's sculpture collection called "The Matter of Time" housed in the Guggenheim Museum in Bilbao.

name: Sotra Skirt Green Stripes

name: Sleepwalker Deep Sea Blue
description: Stay warm in chilly weather with this versatile unisex insulation skirt. Sleepwalker is light as a feather and padded with warm, breathable Primaloft® Black Eco.

name: The Wrap Dress, Black

name: Lala Shirt Dress

description: The Women’s Tree Message Tee from Houdini is a great combination of classic design and innovative textile technology. The t-shirt has a classic cut that feels familiar the first time you put it on but it’s the fabric that really stands out. Woodland Jersey is a Tencel® fabric made from wood pulp. All Tencel™ fibers are certified with FSC® or PEFC™, ensuring sustainable forest management and carry the EU Ecolabel. The Tencel™ factory in Lenzig recycles process water and reuses all chemicals at a recovery rate of more than 99%. Wood is a renewable resource and since we never mix natural fibers and synthetics, the fabric is also completely biodegradable.

name: Jacket Challenge 2.0 Wmn Snow White
description: The Jacket Challenge 2.0 from Dæhlie is perfect for training outside on cold winter days. Consisting of wind and water repellent 3-layer softshell upgraded with PU membrane, designed to keep moisture out, while transporting moisture from the inside, so the jacket both dries quickly and breathes well during high-intensity training sessions. name: Blue Gloria Shirt

name: Benedicte Ski Pants Fucha
description: The Benedicte Ski Pants from Kari Traa are women's ski pants that have a tight fit and a high waist. The trousers combine sensational functionality and sustainability. The articulated knees and shaped crotch allow you to move freely and are therefore perfect for the ski slopes. The wide waist gives you extra comfort and coverage, while the water-repellent treatment ensures that you don't get wet. The trousers are made from recycled, sustainable and ethically produced materials, so you can excel on the slopes with style and an extra clear conscience.

name: Nansen Wool Zip Neck Grey Melange
description: The Nansen Wool Zip Neck in grey melange from Devold is named after  the famous Norwegian explorer, Fridtjof Nansen, who completed the first crossing of Greenland in 1888, dressed in Devold. The Nansen sweaters will perform in the toughest conditions, or make you stand out in the streets. 100% pure new wool from Norwegian sheep. The sweaters with zip neck have a chin guard that prevents chafing caused by the zipper. Comfortable ribbed bottom of the sleeves and body. PLEASE NOTE the sweater is knitted in an unisex model and we recommend women to go down one size.

You can wear the Multiway Pastel Top in many different ways. Tie the trims in any way you desire and get several different tops in one! They are made in Onesize but fits XS to a small M due to the stretchy material. PLEASE NOTE: Photo nr. 4 is a different color than the item listed.

name: Shiny Andorra Trousers
description: The Shiny Andorra Trousers are the perfect lightweight summer trousers. They feature wide, breathable legs and an elastic cord for a nice fit. PLEASE NOTE: these trousers run quite small. We recommend going up one size larger.

description: The Advance Primaloft Down Jacket from Johaug is a feminine, technical and warm jacket with hood for cross-country skiing or other outdoor activities. Elastic panels under the arms and on the back provide optimal movement. Practical pockets with zips. High, warm and adjustable collar. Adjustable and removable hood for extra weather protection. The jacket has metallic details and a feminine and flattering cut. Combine with the feminine and sporty Advance Primaloft Pants and complete your wardrobe!

name: Alberte Backpack Silver Chrome
description: Dear Alberte - where have you been all our life? Everyone knows that the perfect small backpack is hard to come by - so SILFEN made their own special take on an functional but small bag. Alberte is an ideal backpack for festivals, bike trips, shopping (hands free for browsing) and even skiing. Basically anywhere you need a secure bag with a tight fit. The strap is comfortably shaped around the neck for ultimate wearer experience and is designed to be worn across the right shoulder. It is also adjustable in length so you can choose the best fit for your body. Simply slide the bag around to fetch your things without the need to take of the bag. You can store personal belongings in one of the many pockets included in this backpack, front, back side and even a small one on the strap itself. You'll never have to spend time looking for your keys again!  Strap length: 73 -124 cm.

name: Usana Blazer Rib Collar Black
description: Usana is a new blazer from Remain Birger Christensen with a slim fit that creates a feminine look. The visible seams create a cool look on the otherwise classic garment. The blazer has an elastic quality and sits comfortably.

description: Your best friend on a rainy day. Meet BFF Jacket from Houdini, a waterproof and breathable shell jacket in a minimalistic form. It’s the perfect four season adventure buddy and works for everything from hiking, kayaking to even ski touring. BFF Jacket is called best friends forever because it’s designed to be your everyday adventure partner. The waterproof and breathable shell will keep you sheltered from both summer rains and winter blizzards. It’s made from recycled and recyclable polyester and both the membrane and the water repellent are completely PFAS-free. The robust and repairable construction will last for many years and puts the forever in BFF. The jacket is made in waterproof and breathable Surpass 2.5L Hardshell™. It’s a wind- and waterproof shell fabric that is both light, silent and stretchy. Together with the cut, this fabric gives the jacket full freedom of movement and unparalleled comfort. BFF Jacket has an adjustable hood and bottom hem, zippered armpit ventilations, front pockets and articulated sleeves with velcro closures. The jacket is fully seam sealed and has water repellent zippers. If you are looking for a soft, silent and light waterproof jacket that will keep you comfortable for many, many years, this is definitely what you're looking for.

Weight, comfort and ventilation is the answer. The t-shirt model makes a big difference for your sense of weightlessness and the minimalistic design adds to the feeling. You will barely feel that you're wearing Weather Tee, but that extra protection will keep you warm, comfy and well ventilated at all times. name: W's Mono Air Houdi Baremark Green
description: The Mono Air Houdi from Houdini is an innovation both in terms of performance and sustainability. The Mono Air fabric is specifically designed to combat plastic waste. It sheds 80% less microfibers compared to conventional fleece and is made from recycled and recyclable materials. A fleece that is both anti-shedding and circular is nothing less than groundbreaking. When you feel the warmth on a cold ski tour in the backcountry, when you snuggle up during a coffee break at the climbing crag, you should also feel the comfort of contributing to a world without waste. In a conventional fleece, the cut-off fibers that create the fuzzy structure are exposed and can therefore shed from the garment during wash or when you use it. In Mono Air, endlessly long and lofty fibers are knitted into small pockets between a face and back fabric. The pockets trap warm air from your body to create insulation and at the same time protect the insulating fibers from escaping. The face of the fabric is reinforced with a hardface treatment that prevent pilling and snagging. The result is a smooth and strong fabric that will keep you warm and endure years of hard use.

name: W's Tree Message Tee Greeness
description: The Women’s Tree Message Tee from Houdini is a great combination of classic design and innovative textile technology. The t-shirt has a classic cut that feels familiar the first time you put it on but it’s the fabric that really stands out. Woodland Jersey is a Tencel® fabric made from wood pulp. All Tencel™ fibers are certified with FSC® or PEFC™, ensuring sustainable forest management and carry the EU Ecolabel. The Tencel™ factory in Lenzig recycles process water and reuses all chemicals at a recovery rate of more than 99%. Wood is a renewable resource and since we never mix natural fibers and synthetics, the fabric is also completely biodegradable.

name: W's Wadi Pants Mahogany Red
description: The Wadi Pants from Houdini are the ultimate adventure partner in hot, humid weather. The ultralight fabric and the relaxed cut creates a feeling of almost wearing nothing. They provide shelter from the sun but never heat you up or weigh you down. Perfect for any summer adventures but also for yoga or climbing indoors. The fabric is called Liquid Rock and is made from 56% polyamide 38% recycled polyamide 6% elastane, making it extremely durable without adding weight. It has a soft, dry touch against the skin that is very pleasant in hot or humid conditions. The Wadi Pants are the perfect choice if you are looking for a pair of light, cool pants for summer adventures and travelling.

Bionic Finish Eco® technology on the surface of the fabric ensures that light rain and sleet bounce off. Chest pocket with zip. name: Jacket Challenge 2.0 Wmn Snow White
description: The Jacket Challenge 2.0 from Dæhlie is perfect for training outside on cold winter days. Consisting of wind and water repellent 3-layer softshell upgraded with PU membrane, designed to keep moisture out, while transporting moisture from the inside, so the jacket both dries quickly and breathes well during high-intensity training sessions. Designed with quilted padding on the chest area most exposed to the cold, this jacket will keep you warm on even the coldest days. The padding is designed to trap moisture, with a laminated front that ensures that the moisture is not absorbed and freezes in the garment. The strategically placed elastic material in the back and under the arms ensures mobility and ventilation. Rudolf Bionic Finish® Eco technology on the surface of the fabric further ensures that light rain and sleet bounce off, while ensuring good breathability. Insulated with Thermore® Ecodown, which consists exclusively of recycled fibers from PET bottles, this jacket provides warmth with improved durability throughout the life of the garment, while also having a lower environmental impact. Designed as part of a set, you can combine this jacket with the Pants Challenge 2.0 to complete the perfect outfit for cold days!
