description: This chic black velvet hat is a staple you can wear for both everyday and party. Pair it with a white crisp shirt and some sparkly earrings.

name: Knitted Cashmere Dusty Rose Pilou
description: Stylish and functional, this garment can be used as a long or short vest, a dress or a poncho. For extra versatility, layer over a t-shirt or add a jacket.

name: Strapless Midi Dress
description: A simple but sexy midi dress from byTimo. The dress has a tight fit, but made in a soft, stretchy material made for comfort.

name: Kiss Shirt Micro Chip
description: The Kiss Shirt is great for any occasion. The light viscose material makes it perfect for warm sunny days and the long sleeves allow it to be comfortable as the day cools.

name: White Ribbed Sweater
description: This simple white crochet style sweater from Urban Pioneers is a go-to-piece that goes along with everything from your favorite jeans to a dress. The sweater has a rounded neck and tight wrists for a puffed look.

name: Zhou Bright Red Jumpsuit
description: Contemporary yet elegant, this modal-blend jumpsuit features a wrap front to define your waist and pressed creases on the wide-legs to add polish. Appropriate for day or evening.

name: Hemlyyy Embosed Mini Dress SIlver
description: ROTATE Birger Christensen Hemlyy Embosed is a faux-leather, strapless mini dress. Hemlyy has a regular-fit, a folded trim at the neck and an all-over embossed Crocodile patent texture.

name: Grey Melange Knitted Hoodie
description: The perfect knit hoodie for your relaxed days. Combine with jeans or leather pants for a chic look. Lent out by Villoid.

name: Bettina Dress Grey
description: The Bettina Dress from Miss-Candyfloss in Grey is a real beauty. Flaunting a subtle, but deep neckline, a tight-fitting but comfortable bodice, a contrasting waist belt and a flowy, pleated skirt. Made of a firm, yet supple, black-and-white deadstock bouclé fabric (doesn't stretch) that is a joy to wear. Bettina deserves a spot in your wardrobe!

name: Structured Cotton White Mini Dress
description: This structured mini dress is cut in a heavy cotton fabric. The high neck and puffed sleeves is combined with a wide waistband, with pleats along the front. It has flounce details at the bottom of the skirt.

name: Kira Knit Blue
description: The Kira Knit from Maud is a vibrant and playful knitted sweater with a wavy pattern. The knitted jumper has a lovely loose fit with a round neck, wide sleeves and stretchy edges. Comes in two fresh colors. Perfect addition to your autumn and winter wardrobe!

name: Yellow Seffern Dress
description: This long-sleeved shirt dress with buttoning in the front has an asymmetric hemline and comes with a tonal fabric belt to emphasise the waist.

name: Ulrikke Crossbody Wild Rose
description: The Ulrikke Crossbody is a signature style by SILFEN. Made in rPET with silver metal hardware. The 90’s shape beautifully combines an everyday bag with a party look. The single handle is adjustable and make the bag perfect for shoulder bag or crossbody use. Ulrikke comes with matching lining and an internal pocket. A must have bag! The rPET is primarily made of plastic bottles collected from the oceans all over the world. With this bag you can both look your best and keep our planet safe a little more. Strap: Adjustable shoulder strap, can be used cross body. Dimensions: 30 x 20 x 6 cm.

name: Kikicras Skirt Pink
description: Kikicras from Crās is a cool, pink skirt in leather look made from 100% recycled polyester and with statement buttons on the front.

name: The Wrap Dress, Black
description: Work dress, party dress or home robe? You decide. The AWAN Wrap Dress looks and feels great in any situation. Made in silky soft yet durable Tencel™ lyocell jersey from Portugal, the Wrap Dress has a slightly heavier drape than our other dresses, making it even more versatile. The adjustable waist belts wrap comfortably around your body, and the practical pockets are a detail here to stay. Wear alone, or over any AWAN pants.

name: Quilted Mantel Parka Hazelnut
description: The Quilted Mantel Parka from Marina Rinaldi has a classic puffer design, with a straight shape and an faux fur detail around the hood. Be both stylish and warm during the colder months.

name: Sold - Vanya Pure White Dress
description: The Vanya Dress is both ladylike and fashion-forward. It comes in a thick Broderie Anglaise material, and features a deep V-back, long sleeves and a high boatneck.

name: Grey Melange Knitted Hoodie
description: The perfect knit hoodie for your relaxed days. Combine with jeans or leather pants for a chic look. Lent out by Villoid.

name: Printed Light Crepe Ruffled Panel Skirt
description: The Printed Light Crepe Ruffled Panel Dress from Ganni is made from 100% certified recycled polyester. The dress features a round neck, elastic gathered waist, long loose sleeves with elastic details, elastic cuffs and cut-out details at the back with button closure.

name: Black Aske Satin Dress
description: A gorgeous loose-fit maxi dress with removable sleeves. A timeless and elegant classic.

name: Libana Dress
description: The Libana Dress from By Malene Birger is the perfect dress that can be worn for several occasions.

name: Not available - High Neck Smock Dress
Shiny Andorra Skirt
description: The Shiny Skirt in the color Adorra is a simple but chic slip-like skirt made out of heavy and smooth viscose fabric.

name: Cotton Slub Wrap Dress Vintage Flowers
description: The Cotton Slub Wrap Dress from ByTiMo is cut in ByTiMo's light and soft GOTS-certified cotton quality, with slub details in the fabric. It has a mini length and long balloon sleeves with broderie anglaise inserts. The dress has a V-neck and ties around the waist.

name: Vanilla Spring Inger Johanne Skirt
description: The Inger-Johanne is a flirty wrap skirt with a fluid silhouette made from 100% silk. With adjustable waist that makes the skirt drape beautifully over the waist. This skirt is fully lined and is sure to get that summer glow flowing.

name: Perrformance Tech Pant Wmn Iced Aqua
description: The Performance Tech Wmn from Dæhlie is a light baselayer in wool and lyocell blend intended for training in all temperatures. Strategically placed mesh panels under the sleeves provide optimal ventilation. Flat seams and very fine yarn quality provide optimum comfort. A perfect blend of Tencel®, merino wool and technical fiber ensures optimal insulation, quick drying and moisture transport. Like wool, lyocell adapts to a varying body temperature and provides a wonderfully soft surface. The product is suitable for all intensity levels, summer and winter.

name: Queen Ragne Earrings Gold
description: The Queen Ragne Earrings are the perfect statement jewelry. We recommend wearing your hair up to show them off. The earrings are a bit heavy.

name: Adania Thistle Top Yellow Rust
description: The beautiful, cropped blouse Adania from Rodebjer is made in a vibrant allover floral print from the archive of Italian print house Ratti. The blouse has a slouchy silhouette with over-dimensional sleeves and a fitted waist. The floral pattern is printed on heavy satin FSC certificate viscose (Forest Stewardship Council) - which means the organizations works to protecting biodiversity, indigenous peoples' rights, workers rights, and areas of significant environmental or cultural importance.

name: Noritt Dress
description: Noritt Knit Dress is back for Holzweiler AW20. The knitted dress comes in a viscose and nylon blend, has a mock-style neckline and features a large front pocket.

name: Ballon Sleeve Wrap Dress White
description: The Balloon Sleeve Wrap Dress in white from ByTimo is designed with a wide waistband, sidepockets, balloon sleeves and a ruffled hem.

name: Oversized Single-Breasted Blazer Pink
description: Elevate your spring and summer suiting with this Acne Studios blazer. It’s classically tailored from a wool-blend to an oversized fit with structured shoulders, peak lapels, and flap pockets.

name: Pailette Embellished Maxi Dress White
description: The Pailette Embellished Maxi Dress from Soyaaulait is a stunning maxi dress detailed with sequins running along the quarter length sleeves. This dress is the perfect dress for the holiday season!

name: Shoulder Embellished Tunic
description: The Platinum Shoulder Embellished Tunic in Platinum is an oversized button-down tunic. Note: the item does not come with a bow. It is exactly as seen in the model photo.

name: Firda Quilted Jacket Red
description: Combining function and fashion, the knitted and wool insulated Firda jacket has a new take on the traditional puffer jacket. Replacing the traditional down filling, the Firda is padded with wool filling from Norwegian sheep. This is a sustainable and animal friendly alternative to synthetic fiberfill and down filling. You can wear the Firda jacket as a fashion piece in the city or as a statement piece in the slopes.

name: Camilla Jacket Bright White
description: The Camilla Jacket from Kari Traa is a ladies' ski jacket that is very warm. It has warm hand pockets, a goggle pocket and a lift card pocket. The chin guard, the adjustable wrists and the hood ensure that the cold does not get in. Camilla has a down insulation that gives you extra warmth and the chevron seams add a cool touch to the elegant look.

name: Vibeke Shirt Maxi Dress Green
description: The Vibeke Skirt Dress from MagMaLou is a button-up maxi dress with mid-arms that tie at the end. The adjustable belt at the waist allows for a personalized fit and creates a flattering silhouette.

name: Tiered Pleated Silk-Chiffon Dress
description: Channel Carrie Bradshaw by donning this bright blue, tiered, silk-chiffon dress with silver Lurex stripes that she wore in Sex and the City 2. Lower tier starts at the waist. Concealed zip fastening at the back. Fully lined.

name: Black Anna Teddy Jacket
description: This chic teddy jacket has a loose fit and a button closure. So soft, and perfect both for everyday and for more dressed up occasions.

name: Blossom Front Buttoning Embroidery Tunic
description: The Blossom Front Buttoning Embroidery Tunic in Blush is a lovely half button-down tunic with a nice flowy skirt and loose sleeves.

name: Out of stock - Blogger bag Croc Embossed  Grey
description: CLASSIC SAINT LAURENT SHOULDER BAG WITH FIXED STRAP, LEATHER TASSEL AND METAL INTERLOCKING Saint Laurent SIGNATURE.

name: Black Jacquard Mini Dress
description: This beautiful jacquard mini dress is the perfect little black dress. Pair it with some patterned stockings in some sparkly earrings to top off the look.

name: Striped Long Wrap Dress
description: Stay warm during those cold evenings with this stunning wrap dress. Look great at work, during a party, or any occasion. Features shimmering velvet, and a slimming belt for a focused waistline.

name: Zoe Jacket
description: The Zoe Jacket from Meotine is a short black lambskin shearling jacket with leather details. The jacket features a creme colored shearling trim and shearling lining with an off-centre button fastening in the front. Zoe has an oversized fit and dropped shoulders.

name: Sold - S1 Pleated Arm Top Aspen Gold
description: This amazing top has an elegant and feminine look, and features ruffled sleeves. It closes with a hoop in the back of the neck.

name: Raspberry Red Strike Dress
description: This amazing dress features a shirred side and a slightly uneven hem. It has shoulder pads that creates structure, and a lacey pattern for more depth.

name: Black Blow Out Skirt
description: Blow out skirt is a black lace skirt from Holzweiler. The skirt comes with an opaque underlay and has hidden zipper closure on the side.

name: Advance Primaloft Pants Cbrwm
description: The Advance Primaloft Pants from Johaug are feminine, technical and warm trousers for cross-country skiing or other outdoor activities. High and comfortable waist with removable braces. The trousers have Primaloft® Gold insulation in the front which keeps you warm and dry, perfect as ski trousers. Elastic, breathable and warming back panel for optimal comfort and movement. Flattering and feminine fit. Practical zipper at the bottom of the leg.

name: Granateple White Jacket
description: Granateple is a loose-fit, two-piece trenchcoat from the Holzweiler Spring/Summer 2020 collection. The inner vest stops at the calf and has a double-breasted chest with a trench-collar and lapels at the neck.

name: Eva Down Jacket Pine
description: The Kari Traa Eva Down Jacket is a light, water-repellent and super-insulated down jacket for women that will keep you warm in nature here in the north. No cold spots: The effective down filling stays in place and does not leak. Narrow cut and thin diagonal lines with compact padding make it ideal for layering. Super-elastic stretch fabric on the inside of the sleeves and on the sides prevents slipping and gives you full freedom of movement.

name: Floral Guipure Maxi Dress Dark Green
description: With fabric as enchanting as guipure lace, one can hardly be blamed for wanting to wear it from top to toe. This forest green number was designed with a scallop-edged V neck, fitted bodice and full maxi skirt for an exquisite silhouette. Consider it a new go-to for holiday parties, weddings and the opera, finished off with classic pumps and statement earrings.

name: Ikebana Flower Mini Olive Dagrun Short
description: The Ikebana Shirt is a classic staple with a modern twist. The oversized fit combined with the floral print makes it interesting, while still being work appropriate.

name: White Mayra Blouse
description: This 70s-inspired blouse is made in a jacquard fabric. The voluminous sleeves and the adjustable waist gives it a comfy but chic look.

name: Navina Sequin Bird Dress
description: Stunning wrap dress for when you want to make an impression, but also stay comfortable. Body features black sequins on mesh with colorful sequin birds on the shoulders.

name: Silverstone Mesh Leopard Dress
description: A simple silhouette made fun with bold leopard print mesh. Perfect for day or evening.

name: Fam Knit Sweater Light Green
description: The Fam Knit Sweater is a Hést bestseller and signature sweater in a longer model. It is a oversized shape with loose and high neck, wide sleeves and is longer in the back. PLEASE NOTE: someone who wears a small can wear this sweater just as well as someone who wears a large.

name: Wabi Embroidered Bright White Shirt
description: The FWSS Wabi Embroidery Shirt is a crisp 100% cotton shirt with a relaxed fit. Features a contemporary and delicate floral embroidery at front chest, pleasant details like the balloon sleeves with a raglan construction at back, clean collar, hidden button stand and a rounded hem with subtle slits in the side.

name: Sand Poddle99 Blazer
description: This regular fitted blazer features two buttons in the front and is fully lined. It has a patch pocket in front with rounded edges.

name: Cat Dress
description: The Cat Dress from Hope has an interesting checkered pattern that breaks with the contrasting placket and collar in black. Please note that this sample does not come with belt loops nor a belt.

name: Ann-Karin Vintage Floral Skirt
description: The Ann-Karin is a feminine midi-skirt with a beautiful flowery print made of 100% recycled polyester. Features a waistband with a subtle overlapping flap and zipper in the side. A fun and swirly skirt that transitions well from workweek to weekend.

name: Amaka Knitted Tunic Navy
description: Amaka is a knitted tunic which ends above knee length, it’s made in a relaxed fit with sleeves in elbow length. This super soft tunic is designed with long side slits for a comfy and beautiful look and feel. Amaka is produced in an extra fine RWS Merino rib. Shoulders are made in a plain knit for a very flattering shape. It’s made with shoulder epaulettes with big, branded metal buttons.

name: Yvonna Denim A-Line Skirt
description: The Yvonna denim skirt from Collectif x Manillusion is a dreamy A-line skirt in dark denim guaranteed to be an eye-catcher for your western vibes. Made of high quality material with an approx and a 4cm wide waistband with belt loops. the skir fastens at the side with a button and zip, with side pockets and patch pockets at back.

name: Sold - Golden Garden Dress
description: Be garden party ready in this flowery dress with romantic floral pattern and drapey details. Button closure down the front.

name: Juliette Skirt Red Line
description: The Juliette skirt is the perfect, flowy, lightweight skirt to wear with your favorite white t-shirt. The print adds a fun vibe to the skirt, and it features a full lining and closes with a zipper on the side.

name: Didi Dress Pear
description: The Didi Dress from Rodebjer is a comfortable long jersey dress made in a relaxed fit with shoulder seams and short, structured sleeves. It is decorated with slits on both sides and a pocket on the left chest. This is the perfect dress when you don't know what to wear. Didi is a sustainable product made from organic cotton instead of traditional cultivated cotton.

name: Navy Buffalo Skirt
description: A classic pleated skirt made fun with mesh details on the right side. Adjustable waistband with buckle closure.

name: Benedicte Ski Pants Fucha
description: The Benedicte Ski Pants from Kari Traa are women's ski pants that have a tight fit and a high waist. The trousers combine sensational functionality and sustainability. The articulated knees and shaped crotch allow you to move freely and are therefore perfect for the ski slopes. The wide waist gives you extra comfort and coverage, while the water-repellent treatment ensures that you don't get wet. The trousers are made from recycled, sustainable and ethically produced materials, so you can excel on the slopes with style and an extra clear conscience.

name: The Worker Skirt Misty
description: The Worker Skirt is a fun, petite, bell-shaped and thigh-skimming skirt with a low waistline. The skirt is in a firm and good cotton quality and is fully lined.

name: Limly Pale Heather Sweater
description: The Limly Sweater from Theory is a mid-sleeve sweater has a V neckline and classic ribbed trim. It's spun from soft, featherweight cashmere that can be worn throughout the seasons. It is designed to be the foundation of your wardrobe!

name: OOS - Feather Grey Maxi Gown
description: This amazing handmade gown is going to make you feel like a princess. It is made onesize, so it will fit all. The embroidered silk band comes with if you want to accentuate your waist. It has raw edges to accentuate the feather-like material, and it may fringe.

name: Pencil Leopard Skirt
description: This flattering over-the-knee leopard-print pencil skirt is perfect for day or evening. Split in the back provides added comfort. Hidden zipper closure.

name: Ginacras Shirt Shells
description: The Gina Shirt from Cras is designed in this pop neon color with quirky shell pattern. The shirt has flower-inspiring buttons in the front and cuffs.

name: Madelyncras Blazer
description: The Madelyncras from Crās is a double-breasted blazer with sweetheart buttons. The blazer is in a thin, loose material which gives a nice relaxed look. Pair it with The Madelyncras Pants and complete the look!

name: Dusty Rose Alonzo Blazer
description: This chic, pink blazer in corduroy is the perfect statement for fall. Pair over a turtleneck and with your favorite jeans for a stylish look.

name: Purple Flower Chelsea Wrap Dress
description: This wrap dress is covered in a beautiful floral print. Pair it with sneakers or heels, this dress can be dressed both up and down.

name: Day Hibiscus Black
description: The Day Hibiscus Dress from Day Birger et Mikkelsen is a lovely mini dress with a wrap-like effect. The dress has short sleeves, a deep V-neckline and a loose A-line skirt. Can be dressed up or dressed down, you simply cannot go wrong with this dress.

name: Shani Skirt
description: The Shani skirt has the perfect '60s vibe with its mini length, big buttons and pockets.

name: Dk.Camel Alexandra Jeans
description: The Alexandra jeans is a pair of flare denim jeans, and features front patch pockets, belt hoops and a zip-fly opening. Pair with your favorite tee or a chunky knit.

name: Silver Ariana Belt
description: A decorative belt that works great to tie around your waist over dresses, jackets and pants.

name: Tennessee Blouse Black
description: Tennessee from Rodebjer is a relaxed fitted blouse made in a cropped length. The blouse has wide, comfy, and airy sleeves and is designed with side slits and a shawl collar for multiple styling options. It’s made in Rodebjer’s seasonal Vegetal print, printed on FSC certified heavy satin viscose. Designed for a loose fit: for a more narrow fit go one size smaller.

name: Porcelain Rose Sandra Dress
description: This cute ruffle dress is made in cotton, and can easily be dressed both up and down.

name: Gitte Broderie Anglaise
description: The FWSS Gitte Broderie Anglaise is an above the knee dress cut from a 100% cotton broderie anglaise fabric. Features an oversized fit with adjustable drawstrings for a playful silhouette, a slit at neckline and collar with mother of pearl buttons.

name: 1940s Dress Pinafore Blue
description: The 1940s Pinafore Dress from House of Foxy x Manillusion is a classic basic dress inspired from the 1940s. Made entirely of robust linen, it feels pleasantly cool on the skin, even in hot weather. This wonderful dress features side pockets and a V-neckline. It can be worn on its own or dressed up with a matching blouse underneath. Gorgeous this dress in this color.

name: Long Summer Lavender Dress
description: The Summer Dress in Lavender color, is a party dress with a long skirt made in heavy and smooth viscose and the top is made in pliable jersey material. This will be a dream to wear during summer festivities.

name: Sirin Jumpsuit Silver
description: Be dazzling in the Sirin jumpsuit from ROTATE. Decorated allover with sequins, it’s shaped with bishop sleeves, wide legs, and a high-waisted gathered seam for a sculpting cinch.

name: Dots Hot Pink I Love To Love Dress
description: Loose fitting swing dress with long sleeves made in 100% organic cotton.

name: Luini Kombu Green
description: The cute baguette bag. Luini is our new shoulder bag in a baguette bag style, hand made from soft canopy braided lamb leather. Luini is a small, streamlined bag, carried on a short strap which gives us the Carrie vibe. She can be adapted for different looks and stand the test of time. 100% Canopy braided lamb leather. Made in India

name: Mesh Floral Top Yellow
description: The Mesh Floral Top in yellow from Ralph Lauren has an oversized silhouette with a round neck. The details comes from the embroidered floral pattern in the mesh fabric.

name: Dawes Sweater
description: This fluffy sweater is a comfy staple you need in your wardrobe this season. Match with some burgundy pants for a modern monochrome look.

name: Sofie Wide Leg Pants
description: Elegant wide-leg pants that fit exemplify Morck's commitment to craft, quality and sustainability.

name: Pernille Coat
description: The Pernille Coat is the trench coat of your dreams. It is thin and light-weight and comes with a belt and in a beautiful shade between brown and olive green, making this gorgeous coat your new closet staple.

name: Cayline Pure White Dress
description: The Cayline Dress has a sophisticated silhouette combined with a flirty and playful vibe. It is made in a Broderie Anglaise fabric, and closes with four contrast buttons in the front. Wear it as a dress or combine it over your favorite trousers.

name: Terna Skirt Little Boy Blue
description: A lovely skirt from Second female. A skirt that suits both spring and summer.

name: Piaf Shirt Dress
description: The Piaf Shirt Dress from Studio Nicholson has a mandarin collar and buttons down to the waist. The dress is made in a durable and comfortable wool/viscose twill. It features pockets on the sides and an inverted fold at the back which makes the dress fall elegantly.

name: Sold - Heaston Skirt Hushed Violet
description: The Heaston skirt is cut in a slim, flowy silhouette with a shimmering satin finish. It closes with a hidden zip. Wear it with your favorite t-shirt - and dress it up with heels or down with sneakers.

name: Brattespe Shirt
description: The Brattespe Shirt has a boxy and relaxed fit. It has a large collar with cut seam with gatherings on the sleeves that creates a nice volume. This colorful little number will be your favorite summer go-to.

name: Flower Wrap Dress Xenon Blue
description: This flower wrap dress features a V-neck and a waistband to tie around your waist. A versatile dress you can dress both up and down.

name: Printed Mesh Dress
description: The Printed Mesh Dress from Ganni is a colorful and bodycon dress with flattering gatherers, an invisible zipper and reaches to the knees.

name: Usana Blazer Rib Collar Black
description: Usana is a new blazer from Remain Birger Christensen with a slim fit that creates a feminine look. The visible seams create a cool look on the otherwise classic garment. The blazer has an elastic quality and sits comfortably.

name: Zou Bisou Dress Light Blue
description: The Zou Bisou Dress in light blue from Confettibird features an elastic at the waist, belt, shoulder pads, pockets and an unbeatable shape that can adapt to everyone. Details of organza both in the belt, in the wide edge at the bottom of the skirt and in the sleeves. This gives an extra volume effect, and the dress falls perfectly.

name: Vision Stitch Dress Sand
description: The Vision Stitch Dress Sand from Holzweiler is a woven dress, with long sleeves and a round neck. It comes with a zipper at the back, slit at the bottom and stitch details at the sleeves and shoulders.

name: Black Frail Dress
description: Frail is a v-neck lace dress from Holzweiler. The dress comes with ruffles around the neckline and has a fitted waist with button closing.

name: Inger Johanne Madder Brown Skirt
description: The Inger Johanne Skirt is cut in a shiny satin fabric and in a wrap style. The easy fit makes it perfect to dress both up and down.

name: Sold - Mante l Dark Sapphire Dress
description: This flattering wrap dress exudes simple elegance for any occasion. Side-slit adds interest and extra comfort.

description:
-Stella McCartney faux-leather (polyurethane/polyester) shoulder bag with star appliques on front.

name: Rose Dust Tiana Top
description: The Tiana Top is cut in a classic fit, and features an Art Deco-print. It comes with a bow to tie around your neck.

description:
Nina Jarebrinks classic Aldi dress. A dress in a soft and comfortable stretch fabric with flattering draping over the bust and hips.

name: Cala Long Sleeve Black
description: The Cala Knitted Jumper from Skappel is a nice tight-fit long sleeve, made in 15% cashmere and 85% cotton for the softest feeling against the skin. Wear it as is or pair it with the Acasia Knit Trousers for the perfect stylish set!

name: Phantom Polaris Down Coat
description: Polaris has a classic design, with a curved shape and an exclusive expression. It has a water-repellent duratech outer material, and will keep you stylish and warm during the colder months, down to -20 degrees.

name: Jessie Dress Hot Pink
description: The Jessie Dress in hot pink from Confettibird is made in a beautiful velvet quality, in a perfect balance between shiny and matte quality. With its heavy flow and a soft exterior, this gives a luxurious and feminine look. The dress can be easily styled with or without the belt, either for a relaxed look or a more embellished one. The dress is practical to use with pockets on the sides, small puffed sleeves and a lovely frilled edge in the skirt, with an extra layer of organza and tulle to make it just the right amount of play.

name: Out of stock - Harley Vintage White Midi Dress
description: This gorgeous dress is cut in the most flattering silhouette. Perfect for a casual wedding or just for everyday dressing up.

name: Vintage Burberry Trench Coat
description: You really can't go wrong with this Classic Trench Coat from Burberry. The coat is mid length and has a slim fit.

name: Mira Skirt Brown
description: The Mira Skirt in Brown from Stine Goya is an a-line skirt with a button placket and splits at the sides.

name: Oldina Parka Cotta
description: The Oldina Parka from Kari Traa is a women's parka with a normal fit that combines delicious warmth, sustainability and an elegant look. The extra long cut, combined with the high and thick collar, protects you against the most demanding weather. The jacket is fully lined in incredibly warm ethically produced down insulation and the water-repellent treatment ensures that you stay dry.

name: Yugen Black Cardigan
description: The FWSS Yugen Cardigan is a form-fitted cardigan made in a fine 100% merino wool yarn. It features a flattering rib knit, a shape knitted collar, button stand with mother of pearl buttons, and clean cuffs with slits.
